entities.name: Marjana Lipovšek
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marjana Lipovšek is a Slovenian opera and concert singer (mezzo-soprano). The daughter of composer Marijan Lipovšek, she was born in Ljubljana, Slovenia. She retired in 2017 and now lives in her family house in Ljubljana.
